adjudications.decision: Keep an apparent source-system coefficient contrast, exact source assay/substrate/normalization evidence and distinct endpoint/source limitations. No hydrophobic energy, local-site rate or design ranking.

adjudications.objection: Declared condition changes could be invented from an outcome value or unequal source selectors.
